note: Pacing for the runner (scripts/pacing.py, D-486). The two budgets are PLACEHOLDERS: the plan's real limits are not published as token counts and Casey has not read them yet. They are in weighted tokens (see weights), sized from K9's measured tasks (a Sonnet worker plus an Opus review is about 0.5M to 1M weighted tokens). Replace them with measured figures once a usage limit has been hit and its reset recorded in state.usage.limit_hit, or once a quota command (PACING_QUOTA_CMD) reports utilisation, which then wins over this ledger. The runner sets PACING_QUOTA_CMD to quota_cmd_default when the variable is unset; scripts/quota_probe.py reads the session's own plan usage and is verified at the D-486 rehearsal (D-486).

actions_minutes.note: GitHub Actions quota read by Claude from Casey's billing page in his browser on October 29, 2026 (D-494): GitHub Pro includes 3,000 Linux minutes a month on a private repository, reset on the 1st; October's use to the 29th was about 430 minutes (gross $3.44 at $0.008 a minute, billed $0). The runner keeps the month's projected use under the included figure less headroom; with the Rust Ci at the 15-minute warm ceiling plus Twin, Ally and Governance (about 2 minutes together) and a push and a pull-request run per task, a cycle costs at most about 35 minutes, so the month allows about 80 cycles at the ceiling and more as Ci's cache warms.
